key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27064
name: update_object_state
description: Stores a long value into the structure at a fixed field. If the new word is non-negative and differs from the stored word, it saves the word and recomputes a derived word from it and a multiplier field.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27088
name: set_indexed_byte_to_ff
description: Writes the all-ones byte into a global table entry selected by an index register; entries are 24 bytes apart.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:270A6
name: clear_indexed_structure_word
description: Zeroes a 16-bit field of a structure, located from a base pointer, an index register and a fixed field offset. Called by one unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:270B0
name: fill_table_with_swapped_counter
description: Walks a global table of words, writing a counter into each entry with its two bytes swapped and incrementing the counter each step. The loop runs 350 times to fill the whole table.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:270CA
name: initialize_sprite_entry
description: Fills a 50-byte entry of a global sprite table at an index: stores pointers, width and height values, flag words and cleared counters, computes derived bottom and size fields, then calls one unnamed routine to finish.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2715E
name: build_copper_list
description: Writes copper instruction words into a buffer: a header, rows of paired hardware register words for each line derived from the structure's dimensions, and a terminator, then stores the buffer pointers back into the structure and calls one unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27272
name: store_entry_word_pair
description: Stores two input words into fixed fields of an indexed 50-byte entry in a global table, then calls one unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:272B0
name: set_entry_index_rebuild_list
description: If the new index is between zero and forty and differs from the stored one, it saves the index, recomputes a derived offset and writes paired hardware words into a linked buffer before calling an unnamed routine. It then clears a status word.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:272B4
name: update_entry_index_direct
description: Same logic as the indexed variant but uses the index register directly as the entry offset. Saves a new index in the range zero to forty, rebuilds paired hardware words in a linked buffer, calls an unnamed routine, and clears a status word.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27368
name: clear_indexed_table_entry
description: Writes a zero word to the first field of an indexed 50-byte entry in a global table. Called by three unnamed routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2737C
name: set_indexed_entry_all_ones
description: Writes the all-ones word into the first field of an indexed 50-byte entry in a global table. Called by two unnamed routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27390
name: program_blitter_pair_rows
description: When a counter is zero, fills a table of word pairs and then waits for the blitter to go idle, sets its mask and size registers and loops over programming its channel pointers for each row pair before calling an unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:274A2
name: initialize_global_setup_block
description: Stores a set of fixed constant words into global variables and copies two input arguments into neighbouring globals. It then calls two unnamed routines, the first with a pointer to the global block.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2751E
name: fill_sprite_data_table
description: Writes a fixed list of 32-bit hardware word pairs for each row in a buffer, the row count coming from the input structure. The first word in each row increments by 256, and the buffer's end position is stored in a global.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27650
name: dispatch_on_negative_flags
description: Tests several global words and bytes for a negative sign or a particular value, and calls an unnamed routine for each condition that holds.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:276B4
name: clear_flag_sign_call
description: Clears the sign bit of one global word and then calls an unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:276D2
name: copy_rotated_table_rows
description: Repeatedly copies eight bytes from a global table at a stride of ten into a destination buffer at a stride of 120 per row. The source row is chosen by rotating a 4-bit index value each round.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27720
name: clear_second_flag_sign
description: Clears the sign bit of a second global word and then calls an unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2773C
name: copy_rotated_nibble_columns
description: Clears the sign bit of a global longword, then for eight rounds rotates it by four bits and copies fifteen bytes at a stride of ten from a global table into a column of a destination at a stride of 120.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2778C
name: copy_nibble_columns_second_source
description: Performs the same column copy as the neighbouring routine but rotates a different global longword as its index source and does not clear any flag.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27798
name: clear_third_flag_sign
description: Clears the sign bit of a third global word and then calls an unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:277B6
name: clear_fourth_flag_sign
description: Clears the sign bit of a fourth global word and then calls an unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:277D4
name: copy_long_table_with_stride
description: Clears the sign bit of a fifth global word, then copies sixty longwords from a global table into a destination, advancing the destination by thirty bytes per copy.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:277F6
name: reset_flag_words_to_sign
description: Sets the high bit of two flag words and a flag longword, and clears one global word and another flag word.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2781E
name: set_five_flag_sign_bits
description: Sets the high bit of five global flag words and leaves their other bits unchanged.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27842
name: bcd_add_into_digit_array
description: Adds a packed-decimal value byte by byte into a global digit array from its low end, using decimal adjustment and carry propagation over three bytes, then sets the sign bit of a flag longword.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27866
name: bcd_subtract_and_update_flag
description: When a mode word is zero, subtracts a packed-decimal value from a two-byte global digit array, copies a second global word into a flag word and sets or clears the sign bit of a counter depending on a third word. Calls an unnamed routine in one branch.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:278C0
name: bcd_add_and_clamp_counter
description: Adds a packed-decimal value into a two-byte global digit array, then clamps a counter word to a maximum of nine and sets its sign bit.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:278FA
name: bcd_subtract_one_and_flag
description: When a mode word is zero, may reload a second flag word from a third one, subtracts one from a packed-decimal digit array, then sets or clears the sign bit of the second flag depending on another word.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27976
name: bcd_add_clamp_second_counter
description: Adds a packed-decimal value into a two-byte global digit array, then clamps a second counter word to a maximum of nine and sets its sign bit.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:279B0
name: bcd_subtract_set_sign_flag
description: Subtracts a packed-decimal value from a two-byte global digit array with borrow propagation, then sets the sign bit of a flag word.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:279DC
name: bcd_add_set_sign_flag
description: Adds a packed-decimal value into a two-byte global digit array with carry propagation, then sets the sign bit of a flag word.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27A00
name: bcd_subtract_mark_flag
description: Subtracts a packed-decimal value from a two-byte global digit array with borrow propagation, then sets the sign bit of another flag word.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27A24
name: bcd_add_mark_flag
description: Adds a packed-decimal value into a two-byte global digit array with carry propagation, then sets the sign bit of another flag word.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27A48
name: call_routine_eight_times
description: Calls one unnamed routine eight times in a loop.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27A5A
name: run_conditional_update_sequence
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then calls four more only when two global flags are both zero, and finally calls two more routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27B3C
name: scale_word_by_entry_size
description: Returns the low word of its input multiplied by 28, converting an index into a byte offset for 28-byte table entries.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27B4A
name: initialize_object_entry_fields
description: Fills one 28-byte entry of a table at a base address selected by an index: stores a long pointer pair, two input words, a flag byte derived from another input and two fields set to all ones, then writes a fixed value into a global counter.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27B9C
name: store_parallel_table_fields
description: Stores an input word and a pointer-plus-two value into two parallel tables at an index offset, updates a second entry's fields in the same way, and writes a fixed value into a global counter.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27BD0
name: set_object_entry_flags
description: Sets fields of one 28-byte entry: a flag word derived from an input by halving it and setting the low bit, a second word from another input and a final field set to all ones.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27BF4
name: clear_entry_word_if_set
description: Looks up a word in a 28-byte entry of a table at an index; if it is nonzero, zeroes it and sets a global counter to two.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27BF8
name: clear_indexed_word_if_set
description: Clears a word in a table at a plain index offset if it is nonzero, and sets a global counter to two when it does.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27C14
name: set_word_negative_if_zero
description: If a word in a table at an index offset is zero, sets it to minus one and sets a global counter to two.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27CBE
name: write_linked_entry_copper_words
description: Walks a linked list of display entries, writing pairs of hardware words for each entry into a buffer, including a fixed control word and position values taken from the entries, and follows child links until the list ends. Called from the frame wait routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27D7C
name: blit_linked_entry_rows
description: Walks a linked list of entries and, for each one inside a vertical limit, waits for the blitter to go idle, programs its control, mask and size registers, and updates the entry's buffer pointers before moving on.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27EB0
name: fill_control_pair_table
description: Clears a global word, sets a global longword and a counter word, then fills 349 pairs of table words: a control word that is either one of two fixed control words depending on the running value, followed by a value that increases by 256 each pair.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27EE6
name: init_entry_free_list
description: Initialises a free list of 48 sixteen-byte entries in a global block: zeroes each entry's first word, links each entry to the next, and stores the list head pointer.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27F0E
name: allocate_and_fill_display_entry
description: Takes entries from two free lists in turn and fills each with the input value, a pointer, a position derived by dividing the input by a global divisor, and a derived offset, then returns each entry to its list head.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27FC6
name: tick_entry_countdowns
description: Walks a linked list of entries whose first word is nonzero, counting down a per-entry counter. When the counter reaches zero it is reloaded from a second field and an unnamed routine is called, and the walk moves on to the next entry.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:28010
name: step_entry_stream_word
description: Reads the next word from a stream attached to a structure. A terminator restores the structure from a stack of saved records and returns zero; otherwise the word is stored, and if the position falls inside a bounded window the word is marked and the blitter is programmed with its pointer and offset. Returns minus one otherwise.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:28076
name: init_second_entry_free_list
description: Initialises a second free list of 100 eighteen-byte entries in a global block, zeroing the first word of each and linking each entry to the next, and stores the list head pointer.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2809E
name: allocate_and_fill_second_entry
description: Takes an entry from the second free list and fills it using the input value, a pointer, a derived position and a count from another routine, then repeats the fill on a further list and returns the entries.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:28130
name: pop_entry_from_second_list
description: Removes the head entry from the second free list, copies its words and longwords into the structure passed in, and clears its first word; returns zero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2817A
name: tick_second_list_countdowns
description: Walks the second entry chain, decrementing a per-entry countdown; when one expires it reloads the countdown and calls an unnamed routine with a running value, after first calling another routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:281C6
name: advance_entry_counter_and_mark
description: Advances a counter in an entry by two, clamping it to a maximum; writes it to the entry's buffer word and, when the entry's position falls inside a bounded window, marks the word and programs the blitter with its pointer and offset.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:28346
name: setup_blitter_masks_and_modulo
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, sets its first and last word masks to all ones, writes its A and D modulo registers and writes its control register for a copy.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:28372
name: step_multi_state_sequencer
description: Runs one step of a multi-state sequencer. Depending on a state code it selects the next longword from a four-entry table, counts events in a second counter, compares two position values against thresholds to change state, and calls an unnamed routine in one branch. When a step flag is set it subtracts a difference from a global counter.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2849A
name: update_stored_value_on_change
description: Compares an input word with a stored word in the structure; when it changes it stores the new value and sets a state flag. In another branch it stores a value from the input and clears a flag. Afterwards it subtracts a stored difference from a counter field when a step word is nonzero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:284E8
name: reset_state_and_load_value
description: Clears two structure words and a global state word, sets a step word to two, copies a longword from the input structure into the object, and then subtracts a stored difference from a counter when the step word is nonzero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:28660
name: store_mode_and_dispatch
description: Calls one unnamed routine when a global state word equals one; otherwise calls another, and a third only when the input word is nonzero. Stores the input word in a global flag afterwards.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:286CA
name: find_marker_word_row
description: Scans a global word table backwards for the value 84. When it is found, stores an all-ones word and a row position shifted left by four bits into two globals, then returns.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:28714
name: run_numbered_state_machine
description: Dispatches on paired state codes across many numbered states. Each state updates counters, selects values from input-relative tables, changes the state and a mirror state code, and calls an unnamed routine. Called from three unnamed routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:28C5E
name: compute_scaled_offset_value
description: Looks up a signed byte from a global table at a position given by a stored word. When it is nonzero, takes its magnitude, triples values above one, adds a fixed bias when a sign flag is set, adds a fixed base and stores the result in a global.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:28CD4
name: compare_position_direction_bits
description: Compares two pairs of stored position words and stores a direction code in a global: a value when the first pair differs by sign, with flag bits added for the second pair.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:28D10
name: evaluate_delta_thresholds_state
description: Checks a mode byte and a state word, then compares a computed delta against thresholds to set a state code. It calls one of several unnamed routines and, in one branch, writes a counter and two position words derived from stored values.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:28E68
name: claim_free_slot_or_retry
description: When a global flag is clear: if another flag is set, finds the first 28-byte slot whose word is zero, marks it with all ones and calls through a pointer held in a global structure. Otherwise calls an unnamed routine repeatedly until it returns zero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:28EA0
name: select_and_show_display_object
description: Scans a table of object indices for one whose slot word is zero, computes its placement from global values and the input structure, and calls show_display_object to make it visible in both display buffers.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:290DA
name: set_mode_five_and_call
description: Sets a mode word in the structure to five and calls one unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:290EE
name: update_state_on_flag_bits
description: Checks several global flag bits. When they are clear it resets a counter and returns; when they are set it updates a state code and a counter and, in several branches, calls through a function pointer held in a global structure to perform an update.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2927E
name: dispatch_state_with_blit_update
description: Checks a global enable word and several state codes. Depending on them it calls unnamed routines, updates a state code and flags, and, after waiting for the blitter to be idle, writes its control registers.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:294F4
name: set_object_position_from_globals
description: When a global flag is clear and an object pointer is set, copies one word field into another and stores two position values taken from global coordinates offset by fixed amounts.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2952C
name: initialize_object_sequence_state
description: When a counter is zero, sets it to 45 and stores two position words and two constants. It then issues a command through a function pointer held in a global structure when a slot check passes, resets a state word and sets a flag.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2964E
name: locate_marker_and_set_row
description: When a row word is negative, searches two words ahead of a pointer for the value 84; when found, derives a row index by a modulo of a stored value and stores it with a column value. Otherwise it resets the row word to all ones when a state check fails.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:296D4
name: stub_empty_routine
description: Returns immediately without doing anything; the body is a stub.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:296E4
name: check_points_within_tolerance

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:29704
name: reset_and_run_triple_calls
description: Clears a global word, then calls three unnamed routines once, or three times per pass for three passes when a mode word is nonzero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2974A
name: update_countdown_and_scan_entries
description: Counts down a global word and, when it is idle, checks an object's position against a window. If the object lies inside, it scans a table of index words around the object's stored pointer and dispatches to unnamed routines for matching entries, handling codes 272 and 276 separately.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:29B6C
name: copy_word_between_calls
description: Calls an unnamed routine, copies one global word into another, then calls a second unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:29B9C
name: reset_and_hide_display_object
description: Clears a global counter word and calls hide_display_object to hide a display object in both display buffers.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:29BB2
name: tick_nine_slot_countdowns
description: When a flag is set, walks ten three-word slots and counts each nonzero countdown down by one. When a countdown reaches zero and three test calls return zero, it clears that slot's two words and returns the last test result.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:29C22
name: handle_window_range_entry
description: If the input word lies between 160 and 182, stores a type code and a pointer in a structure, calls an unnamed routine and issues a command through a function pointer held in a global structure when a slot check passes. Otherwise returns zero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:29D0C
name: countdown_and_dispatch_command
description: Counts a global countdown down. When it reaches zero and a flag bit is set, it issues a command through a function pointer in a global structure after a slot check; otherwise it resets the countdown to one. Another branch hides a display object.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:29E7A
name: initialize_grid_aligned_state
description: Sets a state code and offsets, aligns two position values to a sixteen-unit grid, copies them into related globals and sets a flag, then issues a command through a function pointer when a slot check passes.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A03E
name: advance_timed_phase_counter
description: When several global counters are zero, runs a timer that reloads at fifty. When it expires it calls an unnamed routine and sets flags, advancing a counter that wraps after ten steps. Otherwise it increments a phase word until it reaches fifty.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A10A
name: countdown_then_call_pointer
description: Decrements a global countdown; when it reaches zero it calls through a function pointer held in a global, otherwise it calls an unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A136
name: dispatch_command_at_state_62
description: When a mode word is set and a state word equals 62, issues a command through a function pointer held in a global structure after a slot check, unless a particular code is already present.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A200
name: tick_counter_and_hide
description: Decrements a global counter and, when it expires, calls an unnamed routine. It then calls another routine and, when a flag is clear, a further one that hides a display object.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A23E
name: check_distance_and_show_object
description: Computes an offset between a global position and an entry's stored value and tests it against window limits. Inside the window it counts a per-entry counter and, when the limits are met, calls routines including show_display_object to make a display object visible.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A3C8
name: arm_timed_callback_state
description: When a field in the entry is zero, sets a state word to two, stores a constant and a zero, installs a callback routine pointer, sets a countdown to 125 and marks the entry as active.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A410
name: reset_timed_state_values
description: When a mode word is zero, calls an unnamed routine, copies a global word, sets a counter to 10000, clears two global words and sets a flag.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A44A
name: reset_position_and_double_field
description: Calls two unnamed routines. When the input word is zero, sets two position words from global coordinates plus fixed offsets and doubles a longword field. Then sets a counter to 10000 and copies a global longword into the entry.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A498
name: initialize_timed_state_block
description: Sets a counter to 10000, clears several flags and globals, sets a state code to three, stores a fixed longword and a callback routine pointer, sets a countdown to 125 and sets two more state codes and a flag.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A4F6
name: number_two_entry_fields
description: Calls several unnamed routines in loops, then writes incrementing values starting at seven into a field of two 28-byte entries.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A590
name: init_entry_and_position
description: Initialises an entry: clears a word, sets a position longword from a global offset chosen by direction, sets a counter and dimension words, calls unnamed routines and copies a position from globals with a constant added.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A610
name: step_two_entry_countdowns
description: For two entries with an active flag, increments an age counter and decrements a countdown. When the countdown expires it clears the flag, calls an unnamed routine and issues a command through a function pointer when a slot check passes. Otherwise it rescales the entry's position values by dividing by 500, multiplies by a fixed factor and adds them to accumulators.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A6E8
name: check_entry_cell_codes
description: For two active entries, looks up the map cell under each entry's position. When the cell holds code 272 or 276 it sets a counter and a value on the entry; otherwise it clears the entry's first word and clamps its counter to twenty.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A788
name: load_cell_values_when_ready
description: When two global words are both nonzero, copies them into state words, sets a flag, reads three map bytes at a position computed from them, stores doubled values and calls four unnamed routines. Otherwise it hangs in an endless loop.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A862
name: replicate_block_three_times
description: Copies a block of thirteen longwords starting at a global address to three consecutive positions after it, repeating the copy from the same source each time.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A882
name: clear_120_byte_block
description: Writes zero to 120 consecutive bytes starting at the address passed in.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A892
name: init_two_entries_by_mode
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then sets fields of one entry from two global values with constants that depend on a mode word, and sets a second entry's fields with different constants.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2A98E
name: advance_position_until_limit
description: While a flag is set, advances a vertical accumulator by a fixed step and adds a velocity to the position. When the position passes a limit it clears the flag and calls an unnamed routine; otherwise it calls another routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2AA02
name: spawn_into_free_slot
description: When the object lies within a range of a global position and a timer is zero, resets the timer to twenty and claims the first free entry of an eight-slot table of twelve-byte entries. It sets the slot position from global values, issues a command through a function pointer when a slot check passes, and calls two unnamed routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2AA20
name: spawn_slot_from_entry
description: Uses an entry's stored position: when the entry lies within a range and its timer is zero, resets the timer to twenty, claims the first free slot of an eight-entry table, sets the slot position from the entry and calls unnamed routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2AAFE
name: init_slot_numbers_and_refresh
description: Stores sequential values starting at ten into the first word of eight table entries, with a zero second word, then calls two unnamed routines in each of eight passes.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2AB3E
name: advance_active_slot_counters
description: For each of eight slots whose counter is nonzero, increments the counter. When it reaches fifty or the slot position passes a threshold, clears the counter and calls an unnamed routine; otherwise moves the slot position back by a fixed amount and calls another routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2ABB8
name: reset_table_pointers_and_counters
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then points six global table pointers at the base of the global area and clears four global words.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2AC16
name: clear_and_number_sixteen_words
description: Clears eight global words, then writes the values zero through fifteen into sixteen consecutive words of a table.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2AC50
name: read_map_byte_or_zero
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then returns the byte at a map position computed from the input pointer, or zero when the pointer is null.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2AC66
name: update_stored_value_with_delta
description: Stores a new value into a history word and records the XOR of the old and new values. It advances an accumulator by a fixed step, copies position fields into a snapshot, adds a velocity term to a derived position and calls several unnamed routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B00C
name: finish_entry_and_set_offset
description: When a flag is set and the entry's flag bit 32 is set, clears related flags, sets a state word to all ones and stores a value derived from two entry fields minus ninety, calling unnamed routines in between.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B0A6
name: reset_state_on_flag_bit
description: When a flag bit is set, calls an unnamed routine and resets a set of state words and codes, including a state code of four and a mode value of two.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B10C
name: sum_bytes_to_checksum
description: Adds up bytes from a start address up to an end address and returns the sum truncated to one byte.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B116
name: advance_table_index_position
description: Counts a delay word down; when it reaches zero it advances a seven-bit index that wraps at 128, then sets a position from a table word times four plus a base value.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B16A
name: set_mode_sequence_values
description: Sets three global values to four, seven and eight when a mode word is zero. Otherwise sets the first to five and the second to two.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B19E
name: tick_mode_counter_reload
description: When a mode word is nonzero, decrements a counter; when it reaches zero it reloads it with five and calls an unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B1CE
name: rotate_word_run_left
description: Rotates a run of words in a global table by one place: the first word moves to the end and the others shift back one slot. The run length comes from the second input.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B1EE
name: copy_six_byte_records
description: Copies a run of six-byte records from a constant table into a global table, saving the first record so that the run is rotated by one record.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B230
name: rotate_two_word_table_run
description: Rotates a run of words in a global table by one place, reading from a constant table at a fixed offset and writing a shadow copy at a second fixed offset.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B27A
name: expand_words_to_longs
description: Converts a run of source words into longwords, shifting each value by four bits and storing the result in the destination buffer.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B2A2
name: copy_masked_words_doubled
description: Copies a run of source words into a destination, masking each to its low twelve bits and writing it twice in consecutive words.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B2BA
name: store_word_or_longword_entry
description: Stores an input value at an indexed position in a global table and a shadow table. When a flag is set it stores a longword instead and records the position with a flag bit in a control word, writing the high word as a second entry.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B2EC
name: store_word_to_two_pointers
description: Writes one input word to two addresses passed in as pointers.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B2F6
name: unpack_packed_fields_to_longs
description: Reads a run of packed values, splits each into fields with shifts and masks, and writes the fields as longwords into a buffer, with a stride set by a flag.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B380
name: busy_wait_short_loop
description: When the input is nonzero, spins a three-iteration empty loop as a short delay.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B404
name: pack_longs_into_records
description: For 256 input longwords, writes a six-byte record per entry by splitting each 16-bit half into nibble and byte fields.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B434
name: divide_word_pairs_by_scalar
description: For 256 rows of two words, divides each source word by the input value and stores the quotient in the destination. The divisor is also kept in a global.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B452
name: divide_differences_by_scalar
description: Splits an input longword into fields and stores a byte pattern in a global. Then computes two quotients, each a source word minus a table word divided by the input value, and stores them in a destination pair.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B48E
name: run_routine_256_times
description: Stores the input value into a global and calls one unnamed routine 256 times, with the value available as a divisor.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B4A4
name: bracket_flag_byte_four_calls

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B4AC
name: mark_word_call_four_times
description: Sets the high byte of a global word, calls an unnamed routine four times, then clears the word.

name: mark_word_four_calls_b
description: Sets the high byte of a global word, calls an unnamed routine four times, then clears the word.

name: mark_word_four_calls_c

name: mark_word_four_calls_d
description: Sets the high byte of a global word, calls an unnamed routine four times, then clears the word.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B530
name: clamp_and_subtract_word_pairs

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B5B0
name: process_rows_with_constant_setup
description: Initialises several global words to constants, then loops over a source table calling unnamed routines to process each row.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B710
name: fill_global_longs_with_value
description: Fills 256 longwords of a global buffer with the input longword, then stores its low word in another global.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B728
name: copy_256_longwords_to_global
description: Copies 256 longwords from the source address passed in into a global buffer.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B73A
name: count_matching_entry_nodes
description: For each active entry, walks a linked list of words and counts the even values inside a fixed range, calling unnamed routines to process the results.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2B7F2
name: call_until_flag_one

name: call_until_flag_one_3
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine until the second input word equals one.

name: call_until_flag_one_4
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine until the second input word equals one.

name: assign_values_to_matching_nodes
description: For each active entry, walks its linked list of words and, for each even value inside a fixed range, writes the next value from a source list into that node, stopping when the count reaches the limit.

name: stub_empty_return_routine

name: scan_cells_in_value_range
description: After reading a two-character tag, scans a rectangular table of words and calls an unnamed routine for each word that falls between two input bounds.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2BBC2
name: write_digit_character_output
description: Chooses between text sources based on flags. When a counter is in use, writes its value as an ASCII digit, offset by 48, into a text buffer, then calls unnamed routines.

name: load_digit_indexed_word

name: read_next_text_byte
description: Reads the next byte from a text pointer and advances it. A zero byte is returned as the end of the string. A byte with its high bit set rewinds the pointer to the start, sets a flag and is returned.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2BE52
name: set_text_pointer
description: Stores the input address as the current text pointer.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2BE5A
name: reset_text_pointer
description: Points the text pointer back at its base address and sets a flag.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2BE6E
name: step_text_pointer_back
description: Decrements a counter and moves the text pointer backwards while the preceding byte is non-negative, returning the byte found.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2BE9C
name: advance_frame_stage_sequence
description: Starts a frame stage update: calls two unnamed routines, sets a mode word to three and calls another routine when a control flag is set. Then clears flags and, when a stage flag is set, walks a sequence of counters that set a stage code and reset counters.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2BEA4
name: advance_frame_stage_from_mid
description: Shares the body of the neighbouring frame stage routine, entered after its first unnamed-routine call.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2BEAC
name: advance_frame_stage_from_tail
description: Shares the body of the neighbouring frame stage routine, entered after its first two calls are skipped.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2BEAE
name: build_display_copper_setup
description: Sets a display state, calls three unnamed routines, then writes a fixed copper setup of control words, bitplane and display window values into a list and stores a pointer to its end in a global.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2C128
name: fill_increasing_longword_ramp
description: Writes 32 longwords into a buffer, each 131072 more than the previous one, starting from a fixed base value.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2C15E
name: build_limited_value_list
description: Clears a table word and, when two flags are clear, writes up to 32 longwords into a list, each step adding a stored value and keeping only values below a fixed limit, calling unnamed routines as it goes.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2C208
name: build_palette_entries_from_table
description: When a flag is clear, converts 30 words from a table into color-register values by halving their 4-bit channels, and writes each as a longword into a list after a leading header value.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2C29E
name: reset_frame_counters_and_calls
description: Copies a global word into another, calls three unnamed routines, clears four global words, decrements a counter when it is nonzero, clears one more word and calls another unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2C2F4
name: set_tag_and_call_routines
description: Stores a four-letter ASCII tag in a global longword, calls unnamed routines twice, then stores the result of another routine in a global.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2C322
name: compute_layout_from_scale
description: Sets several layout globals from a stored scale: a base value that triples in one mode, a doubled value, an offset from a scaled value clamped at zero, and a second offset from another byte clamped at zero, plus a product of two values.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2C38C
name: reset_state_and_run_calls
description: Calls five unnamed routines, clears a few state globals, sets position-like globals to fixed values, then calls further routines in sequence, twelve in total.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2C460
name: reset_all_runtime_globals
description: Clears a long list of runtime global words and flags to zero or a fixed initial value, then calls about forty unnamed routines to set up the remaining state.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2C800
name: clear_word_at_stride_fourteen
description: Clears a word at offset two in each of three records spaced fourteen bytes apart.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2C81A
name: clear_words_in_pointed_list
description: If a stored pointer is set, clears a word at offset two in each of fourteen entries spaced four bytes apart, starting at that pointer.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2C832
name: call_routine_200_times
description: Calls one unnamed routine 200 times in a loop.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2C848
name: dispatch_on_counter_value
description: When a counter equals 19 calls one unnamed routine, and when it equals 20 calls another.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2C87C
name: call_five_routines_if_flag
description: When a global flag is set, calls five unnamed routines in sequence; otherwise does nothing.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2C8FA
name: compare_positions_and_adjust
description: Returns early for one state code. Otherwise compares a summed position with a reference position and, depending on a mode word and the sign of the difference, calls unnamed routines to adjust it.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2CA24
name: apply_offset_on_mode_change
description: When a mode word equals one, sets it to minus one. If a second flag is clear, subtracts a fixed offset from a longword field and sets that flag.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2CA70
name: stub_no_op_routine
description: Returns immediately without doing anything; the body is a stub.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2CAE2
name: update_mode_on_negative_entry
description: When a field is nonnegative and a flag bit is clear, looks up a table entry from an offset. If that entry is negative it flips or decrements a mode word, otherwise it resets the mode word to zero. When the flag bit is set it clears a second flag.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2CB48
name: call_until_value_matches
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine, keeping its returned word, until the returned value equals the second input word.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2CB54
name: load_indexed_table_row_values
description: When a flag is clear, reads a row from a table selected by a global index. If its first word is zero it sets a scaled value from the second word times 50 and another from the third word; otherwise it clears the scaled value. It also sets a base position when an offset word is nonzero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2CFAA
name: spread_value_across_sixteen_words
description: Splits a global word by sixteen into a quotient and remainder, writes the quotient to sixteen consecutive words, then adds the remainder to the last word.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2CFCC
name: call_routine_three_times
description: Calls one unnamed routine three times.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2CFF2
name: copy_indexed_block_words
description: Copies 32 words from a block in a global table, whose position comes from an input code minus 49 times 64, into a fixed global buffer.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:0000
name: store_inputs_and_call_handler
description: When a global flag is set, calls an unnamed routine, then stores the input registers into global fields and sets a handler pointer, returning a combined result.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:0004
name: call_for_each_active_byte
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then calls another routine for each of four global bytes that is not minus one, using the sentinel value to skip unused entries.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:0010
name: step_audio_channels
description: Counts a global countdown down and resets it to six when it expires. Otherwise steps through the audio channel register blocks to update channel state.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:00CE
name: set_audio_channel_control
description: Updates the state table entry for an audio channel number. Returns early for channel three in one state; otherwise marks the channel slot with all ones and programs that channel's audio registers.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:0130
name: set_audio_channel_field
description: Writes a byte value into one of several fields of an audio channel block, chosen by a small field code.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:013C
name: set_audio_channel_byte_pair
description: Stores an input byte into one of two fields of an audio channel state block selected by a code, then updates a counter when a global byte is zero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:0148
name: enable_audio_channel_bit
description: Sets the bit for the chosen audio channel in a global mask when the mask bit is clear, and writes one to that channel's period register.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:02B6
name: update_audio_channel_registers
description: Updates a channel's volume and period register fields from a set of global state bytes for the selected audio channel.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:02DA
name: reset_countdown_to_six
description: Sets a global countdown to six.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:02EC
name: step_audio_channels_2
description: Counts a global countdown down and resets it to six when it expires. Otherwise steps through the audio channel register blocks to update channel state.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:031A
name: advance_sound_channel_records
description: Walks a list of sound-channel records, reading a byte from each record's data table at a position taken from a counter. Depending on record flags it advances counters, masks table bytes to two bits, updates the record state and calls unnamed routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:0392
name: update_sound_record_deltas
description: Walks sound-channel records, clears a flag bit in each one, and when the record's table byte is not the sentinel computes a difference between two global table entries and updates the record, calling unnamed routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:0432
name: compute_record_scaled_value
description: For each sound record with one flag bit clear and another set, computes a scaled value from two record fields by multiplying words and subtracting, writes the result into the record and calls an unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:049A
name: update_record_counter_by_code
description: Walks sound records and updates a per-record counter by a code value: increments it when the code is four, sets it to minus one for other codes except eight, then calls an unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:0556
name: update_record_counter_by_flag
description: Like its neighbour, updates a second per-record counter: increments it when the code is sixteen, sets it to minus one for other codes except thirty-two, then calls an unnamed routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:05BC
name: reset_sound_record
description: Sets a channel bit in a global, sets a record's flag to one and clears its state words and counters.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:061A
name: clear_word_and_set_globals
description: Clears a word at the input pointer, sets a global to one and then to 255, and returns the input value with some fixed bits set.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:085E
name: copy_table_and_set_defaults
description: When an init flag is set, clears it and copies 64 longwords from a constant table into a global block. Then sets a global value from a sequence of byte checks against minus one and calls three unnamed routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:08C6
name: return_input_byte
description: Returns its byte input unchanged.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:1:094C
name: store_inputs_handler_2
description: When a global flag is set, calls routines, then stores the input registers into global fields and a handler pointer. The remaining branches dispatch on flags.
